purpose: Isolated S29 review proposal; not loaded by runtime, not replacing or approving v1. No medication regimen fields. C-SSRS periods past_month/past_3_months/lifetime inform current_encounter synthesis with structured provenance.

fields.definition: Schizophrenia status represented by the scenario; registration diagnosis review establishes Yes/No for this encounter.
fields.source_locator: project-documents/medical-documents/guideline/STATEMENT-08.md — Implementation (schizophrenia context); diagnosis v1 supplies structured diagnosis, this field is the reviewed encounter synthesis
fields.operationalization: Yes requires a documented current schizophrenia diagnosis review at this encounter; No requires a documented assessment finding schizophrenia not established. Unknown assessment pauses. Copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record (C-SSRS item responses and definition version where applicable); copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Clinician synthesis of substantial suicide-related risk; informed by structured C-SSRS past_month ideation, past_3_months behavior and lifetime history with provenance, never a scale level alone.
fields.source_locator: project-documents/medical-documents/guideline/STATEMENT-08.md — Implementation; content/assessments/cssrs.v1.json past_month ideation, past_3_months behavior, lifetime
fields.operationalization: Yes requires clinician synthesis of substantial risk from structured C-SSRS with provenance: past_month ideation levels 1-5, past_3_months behavior (actual/interrupted/aborted/preparatory, NSSI separate), lifetime history, intensity/lethality kept separate, plus modifiable/static context. A single scale level alone never maps Yes. No requires completed structured assessment finding no substantial risk. Missing synthesis pauses. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record (C-SSRS item responses and definition version where applicable); copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Persistence of suicide-related risk despite other treatments; distinct from the two-trial treatment-resistance construct.
fields.source_locator: project-documents/medical-documents/guideline/STATEMENT-08.md — Implementation (risk remains substantial despite other treatments)
fields.operationalization: Yes requires documented persistence of suicide-related risk despite other treatments with treatment context and window; distinct from two-trial resistance. No requires assessment finding risk did not persist despite treatment. Unknown pauses. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record (C-SSRS item responses and definition version where applicable); copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Clinician-determined urgent safety concern from saved structured C-SSRS and urgent inputs at this encounter; displayed independently of estimation latency.
fields.source_locator: project-documents/medical-documents/guideline/STATEMENT-08.md — Implementation; Harms; content/assessments/cssrs.v1.json urgent inputs (saved assessment, clinician-determined)
fields.operationalization: Present means clinician identifies an urgent safety concern from saved structured C-SSRS and urgent inputs during current assessment; Absent means urgent assessment was completed without identified concern. This banner renders from saved inputs independently of estimation latency and is never a model-computed risk percentage. Unknown assessment pauses. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record (C-SSRS item responses and definition version where applicable); copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: An adherence problem or uncertainty about treatment exposure represented in the scenario.
fields.operationalization: Yes means clinician identifies an adherence problem or exposure uncertainty; No means adherence review found no identified concern. Unknown pauses. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record (C-SSRS item responses and definition version where applicable); copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Presence of modifiable suicide-risk factors that can serve as intervention targets.
fields.source_locator: project-documents/medical-documents/guideline/STATEMENT-08.md — Implementation (modifiable risk factors as intervention targets)
fields.operationalization: Yes means clinician identifies at least one modifiable suicide-risk target for intervention planning; No means review found none. Unknown pauses. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record (C-SSRS item responses and definition version where applicable); copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Never, current or previous clozapine treatment represented in the scenario.
fields.operationalization: NeverTreated requires explicit assessment of no prior or current clozapine; CurrentTreatment/PreviouslyTreated require documented status with encounter/window. Unknown history pauses. No dose/route/frequency collected. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record (C-SSRS item responses and definition version where applicable); copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.operationalization: Yes means patient is willing to discuss clozapine after shared discussion; No means unwillingness or unresolved concerns documented. Missing discussion remains unknown, not No. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record (C-SSRS item responses and definition version where applicable); copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Availability of a clozapine monitoring and follow-up plan per current prescribing information.
fields.operationalization: Yes means a clozapine monitoring and follow-up plan is available per current prescribing information; No means no such plan available. Unknown pauses. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record (C-SSRS item responses and definition version where applicable); copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.
